Title: [LSJ] Bajazet Al-Nasir and timing for agg hand strikes

Messages.Author: the_capuchin
Messages.Body:
Hi,

Sorry if it's been asked before - i've made a search for 'bajazet hand
strikes' and got nothing - but I'd like to confirm an idea I had
recently.

follow the same timing of other cards who do the same - such as Wolf
Claws, Bone Spur, Claws of the Dead etc.? Can I announce a hand strike
and burn the blood after the declaration of the opposing minion's
strike?

many thanks,

the_capuchin
